# FinCalcHub Marketing — Financial Calculator Suite

> 15 professional calculators for financial analysis, marketing metrics, investment planning, and everyday math. All calculations execute client-side in the browser. Zero server data transmission. Zero account required.

- **URL:** https://fincalchub.xyz
- **Platform:** Static single-page application (PWA-capable)
- **Last Updated:** 2025-07-20
- **Total Tools:** 15 (13 tab-based + 2 modal-based)

---

## Calculator Inventory

### Marketing Analytics Suite
- **RoAS Planner** (`#roas`) — Return on Ad Spend calculator with break-even analysis, daily campaign tracking, and profitability status indicator. Formula: Active RoAS = Revenue ÷ Ad Spend; Break-Even RoAS = 1 ÷ Gross Margin %.
- **A/B Split-Test Engine** (`#ab-test`) — Two-proportion Z-test for statistical significance of conversion rate differences. Outputs confidence score, Z-score, relative uplift, and sample adequacy.

### Business & E-Commerce Suite
- **SaaS CAC & LTV Engine** (`#saas-metrics`) — Customer Acquisition Cost, Lifetime Value, LTV:CAC ratio, ROI, payback period, and gross margin. Healthy target: LTV:CAC ≥ 3:1, payback < 12 months.
- **E-Commerce Profit Suite** (`#ecommerce-profit`) — True per-unit profit after product cost, shipping, platform fees (Shopify/Amazon/Daraz), payment gateway charges, and advertising spend.
- **Profit Margin Calculator** (`#profit-margin`) — Profit amount, margin % (profit ÷ revenue), and markup % (profit ÷ cost). Explains the margin vs. markup distinction.
- **Invoice Tracker** (`#invoice`) — Gross invoice calculation (rate × hours), platform fee deduction (Upwork/Fiverr), tax withholding, and true net earnings breakdown.
- **Freelancer Hourly Rate** (`#freelancer-rate`) — Ideal hourly/daily rate based on income goals, expenses, billable hours, tax rate, vacation days, and profit margin target.

### Personal Finance & Tax Suite
- **Compound Interest Calculator** (`#compound-interest`) — Future value with compound interest plus optional monthly contributions. Interactive growth chart. Supports annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, and daily compounding. Formula: FV = P(1 + r/n)^(nt) + PMT[((1+r/n)^(nt) − 1)/(r/n)].
- **SIP Investment Planner** (`#sip`) — Systematic Investment Plan maturity projection with interactive portfolio growth chart. Formula: Maturity = PMT × [((1+r)^n − 1)/r] × (1+r).
- **Income Tax Calculator** (`#income-tax`) — Pakistan progressive tax slabs for salaried and self-employed categories. Shows effective rate, monthly deduction, take-home pay, and slab-by-slab breakdown.
- **Savings Goal Calculator** (`#savings-goal`) — Monthly savings needed to reach a specific financial goal with investment returns factored in.
- **Retirement Planner** (`#retirement`) — Inflation-adjusted retirement corpus calculation with monthly savings required. Accounts for current age, retirement age, life expectancy, inflation, and expected returns.

### Crypto & Currency Tools
- **Crypto Converter** (`#crypto`) — Real-time Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana conversion to 8 fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, PKR, INR, AED, CAD, AUD) via CoinGecko public API. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.

### General Utility Calculators (Modal-Based)
- **Simple Calculator** — Instant addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentage operations. Zero-latency, client-side arithmetic. Formula: Output = Input_A [+, −, ×, ÷] Input_B.
- **Scientific Calculator** — Advanced engineering math: sin(), cos(), tan(), log(), ln(), √x, x², x^y, π, ±, parentheses grouping. All operations execute locally.

---

## Platform Features

### Global Currency System
- 8 supported currencies: USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), PKR (Rs), INR (₹), AED (د.إ), CAD ($), AUD ($)
- Centralized `appState.currency` state object
- All calculator labels, symbols, and results update instantly on currency change

### Data Export (Per Calculator)
- **PDF Export** — Print-ready report via jsPDF (lazy-loaded)
- **CSV Export** — Comma-separated values via Blob Data URI
- **XLSX Export** — Spreadsheet via SheetJS (lazy-loaded)

### Save & Share
- **Save to Browser** — localStorage persistence per tool with 30-day expiry
- **Share Calculation** — Web Share API (navigator.share) with clipboard fallback. Generates parameterized URLs (e.g., `/#sip?m=10000&r=12&y=10`)
- **Reset** — Clears inputs back to platform defaults

### Deep Linking
- Every calculator has a unique URL hash slug (e.g., `/#income-tax`, `/#compound-interest`)
- Shared URLs with query parameters auto-restore calculator inputs
- Browser Back/Forward navigation fully supported via History API

### PWA Support
- Installable on mobile home screens and desktop
- Service worker (`sw.js`) for offline caching
- Web App Manifest with 9 icon variants (16px to 512px, SVG, ICO, maskable)
- 4 app shortcuts (Crypto, Income Tax, Compound Interest, SIP)

### Interactive Charts
- Compound Interest: Stacked bar chart (Principal + Contributions + Interest over time)
- SIP Planner: Stacked bar chart (Invested vs Returns over time)
- Charts powered by Chart.js (lazy-loaded from CDN)

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Rendering:** Single-page application, all inline CSS/JS
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4.3.2 (compiled) + custom CSS
- **Font:** Inter (Google Fonts, async loaded)
- **APIs:** CoinGecko (crypto prices), Google Tag Manager (analytics, deferred 4.5s)
- **Hosting:** Vercel / Cloudflare Pages compatible
- **Security:** CSP headers, X-Frame-Options: DENY, no external data transmission from calculators
- **Responsive:** Fluid design from 320px (ultra-small mobile) to 2560px+ (ultra-wide 4K)
- **Accessibility:** ARIA labels, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, reduced-motion support, high-contrast mode support
